title: fix(skills): three objectstack-ui record-page eval cases grade what the record-page rule teaches
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu3zQ2AqeghSGpv6Q7VEPDyQ)_

Fixes #37632

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户无感：只改了技能包里三道“记录页”评测题的题面与判分词，评测轮不再把照技能写对的答案判错。
- 替每一轮给界面技能打分的评测解决问题：三道题此前与已发布的记录页规则不一致，或把答案里引用的旧写法当成错误。
- 出错时只会让这三道题的得分偏高或偏低，不影响任何运行中的应用，回退本次合并即可撤回。
- 无

## What changes

One file of eval fixtures, `skills/objectstack-ui/evals/record-page.json`, cases 1, 3 and 4, plus a `@objectstack/skills` patch changeset. No skill text changes.

- **Case 4 (drop the Attachments tab).** `must_contain` no longer requires `'sys_activity'`; it requires `'opportunity_contact_role'`, the second list the prompt asks to keep. The reference answer is now `relatedLists: ['quote', 'opportunity_contact_role']` and says approvals and the activity stream still follow when unlisted (naming both is right too). This is `rules/record-page.md` §2: "Declared, only the named lists show, in order (unlisted approvals and the stream still follow)".
- **Case 1 (Tasks tab first).** I kept `relatedListFilter` required and changed the prompt: it now asks for the Tasks tab first and for that tab to list only the open tasks (a task whose `status` is not `done`). Reason: §2 teaches two things here, the tab list and `relatedListFilter` on the child's reference field, and this case is the only one in the catalog that grades `relatedListFilter` (the key occurs in this eval file and in §2, nowhere else under `skills/`). Dropping the assertion would leave that teaching graded by no case. The reference answer now lists `['task', 'event', 'sys_attachment']` and says approvals and the stream need no entry, for the same §2 reason as case 4. Once declared, only the named lists show, so listing the task alone would take the Events and Attachments tabs away (`deriveRelatedLists.ts`, pinned by `deriveRelatedLists.relatedListsOrder-27069.test.ts`). `must_contain` now also requires `'event'`, so an answer that drops the Events tab fails (contract review 7204269799, S1 and N1).
- **Case 3 (`placedActions: true` on `page:header`).** The forbidden string `actions: ['` becomes `actions: ['open`. The wrong answer this case guards against lists the package's action id beside or in place of `placedActions: true`; an answer that quotes the page's old id list in a `// before:` comment no longer fails. Same treatment as the earlier forbidden-string sweep (PR 31436): forbid the spelling a wrong answer writes, not any mention.

Each of the three cases has a new case hash, so a `skill-evals --regrade` of a round recorded before this change sets them apart.

## Tests

Head `ddc29c8379` (delta: case 1's reference sentence and its `'event'` token; the readings below were taken on `36f7a970cc`, and the hand check was re-run on the new head: 6 cases, 0 violations).

- Evals: NOT MEASURED. No model runner in this container, so the three cases were not re-run against a model.
- `node ui/scripts/check-skill-eval-tokens.mjs`: exit 0, "Every must_contain token is taught by its own skill bundle." See the first acceptance note for what this gate does and does not read.
- Hand check over the edited file: no `must_not_contain` entry of any of the six cases occurs in its own `expected_output`; every `must_contain` entry of cases 1, 3 and 4 occurs in its own `expected_output` (6 cases, 0 violations).
- `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`: exit 0, "61 authored bundle file(s) within their ceilings; 11 generator-owned file(s) and 42 eval fixture(s) measured, not ratcheted." No ceiling changed.
- Derived gates (`dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`, 44 commands): 39 exit 0. Five exit 3 (prerequisite, no build in this worktree; NOT MEASURED locally, left to CI): `check:doc-formula-expressions`, `check:dts-closure`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure`, `check:sourcemap-no-sources-content`. They read build output, not this diff's two files. `pnpm check:changeset-fixed`: exit 0.

Size readings (published catalog):

| Reading | Before (`fbcfdfbb58`) | After (`36f7a970cc`) |
|:--|--:|--:|
| `record-page.json`, lines | 118 | 118 |
| `record-page.json`, tokens (ratchet's count) | 1826 | 1923 (at `ddc29c8379`; 1924 at `36f7a970cc`) |
| All `SKILL.md` files, lines | 4961 | 4961 |
| Whole shipped tree, tokens | 299752 | 299849 (at `ddc29c8379`) |

## Acceptance notes

- `ui/scripts/check-skill-eval-tokens.mjs` scans one bundle, `skills/objectui` ("Scanned 1 skill bundle(s) under skills: 11 eval file(s)"). It does not read `skills/objectstack-ui/evals/`, so its green says nothing about this file; the hand check above stands in for it. Noted, not filed: coverage observation, no wrong answer at a public entry.
- §2 was checked against the code and holds. `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/synth/buildDefaultPageSchema.ts` (`arrangeDeclaredTabs`, around lines 1151-1172) drops an unlisted attachments tab and places unlisted approvals and the stream after the listed tabs; `RelatedListsEditor.tsx` (around lines 269-276) previews the same.
- Case 3's narrowed string catches an id list that starts with an `open…` id (the prompt's "Open in billing"). An answer that sets `placedActions: true` and also lists other ids first would pass the string check; the runtime refuses that pair. No narrower literal separates it from a quoted old list.
- Case 6's reference answer and the `record-page.json` entry in `skills/objectstack-ui/evals/README.md` ("naming every tab it keeps") still name the two built-ins or speak of every tab. Both are valid authoring and outside this card's three cases; left as they are.

### Accepted deviations (contract review 7204269799)

- N2: the tokens `'quote'` and `'opportunity_contact_role'` in case 4, and `'event'` in case 1, are whole quoted names. An answer that writes the `object.field` form (`'quote.opportunity'`, `'event.lead'`) fails, even though the spec accepts it. §2 teaches bare names, and the measured answer wrote them.
- N3: in case 3, `actions: ['open` only matches a single-quoted id that starts with `open`. An answer that pairs `placedActions: true` with another id (for example `actions: ['billing_open']`) passes, even though the spec refuses that pair. An id list without `placedActions: true` still fails on `must_contain`.

## Verification

Read first, by risk:

1. `skills/objectstack-ui/evals/record-page.json` case 1: the prompt sentence and the reference answer (the one prompt change in this PR).
2. Same file, case 4: `must_contain` and the reference answer against §2 of `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/record-page.md`.
3. Same file, case 3: the one forbidden string.

Two-minute check: `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` prints `skills/objectstack-ui/evals/record-page.json is 1923 tokens — eval fixture, measured but not ratcheted` and ends with the green line quoted above.
